name: @intellectual-frontiers/commons
description: IFC Docs, for the development of commons/docs: the generator of a repository's documentation site, made from its TypeScript and its spec kit alone (commons 0011-documentation). A repository depends on the repository's root package by Git and imports it as @intellectual-frontiers/commons/docs.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun test suite/ && bun main.ts check
